description: This Java source file defines the class FlexibleMapAccessor, which provides a flexible way to access and manipulate values within a Map data structure using dot notation and bracketed syntax. It supports nested expressions, localization, and caching of compiled expressions to improve performance.

classes.name: FlexibleMapAccessor
classes.description: A utility class that allows flexible access to Map entries with support for nested expressions, list indexing, and localization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to obtain an instance of FlexibleMapAccessor for a given expression string, utilizing caching.

methods.description: Checks if the accessor contains a nested expression (e.g., dynamic evaluation).

methods.name: getOriginalName
methods.description: Returns the original expression string used to create this accessor.

methods.name: getIsAscending
methods.description: Indicates whether the sorting order is ascending according to the expression's prefix.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether this accessor has an empty expression.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the provided Map based on the expression, supporting localization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overloaded method; retrieves value with optional locale consideration.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Sets a value in the Map at the location specified by the expression.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the value at the expression's location from the Map.
